item.title: AI 队友：monday.com 如何在 Amazon Bedrock 上运行生产级 AI 智能体
item.summary: AI Teammates are agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock, and few engineering organizations run them in production at the scale that monday.com does. Nine in ten Builders use AI coding tools every month, up from roughly half a year ago. Per-engineer PR throughput is up by more than half. Every figure in this post comes from monda
